structured_output.summary: POST /links now accepts an optional expiresInSeconds. It must be a positive integer, otherwise the response is 400 {"error":"invalid expiresInSeconds"} and no link is created. GET and HEAD /:slug return 410 {"error":"expired"} once now() - createdAt >= expiresInSeconds*1000, and that visit is not counted as a click. All time checks use the injected now(). Added test/expiry.test.js covering invalid values, the valid 201 shape, the exact boundary, HEAD, clicks unchanged after expired visits, and links without the field never expiring. npm test passes (9 tests).
